segments.text: Hello, this is Dr. Hale's clinic. How can I help you today?
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: Hi doctor, I'm calling about the headaches I've had for about 2 weeks, mostly in the evening.
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: I see. Did you check your blood pressure at home like we discussed?
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: Yes. This morning it was 135 over 85, and last night 140 over 90.
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: Okay. Those readings are a little higher than the target we set, which was under 130 over 80.
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: Not yet. Keep taking the 5 milligram tablet once a day, and cut down on salt and coffee.
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: Also try to drink at least 2 liters of water a day and go to bed before 11.
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: Okay. Should I stop the ibuprofen I take for the headaches?
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: Please limit it to 2 tablets a day and not more than 3 days in a row.
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: Understood. What should I write down until the next visit?
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: Write your blood pressure every morning and evening, and note when each headache starts.
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: I'll do that and bring the notebook with me.
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: Good. Let's see you again on Tuesday the 14th at 9:30 in the morning.
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: Tuesday the 14th at 9:30, got it. One more thing, I want to ask next time whether I need a blood test.
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: We can talk about that at the visit. Call the clinic if the headache gets suddenly much worse.
segments.speaker: S1
